title: Create: Dreams n' Desires Updated to Create 6
description: This is an addon to Create: Dreams n' Desires that makes it compatible with Create 6. THIS DOES NOT USE ANY ORIGINAL ASSETS FROM DREAMS AND DESIRES!!
body:
**_⚠️ This mod does not use or redistribute any assets from Create: Dreams n' Desires. ⚠️_ and is __not compatible with Sinytra Connector__**

# Create: Dreams n' Desires to Create 6

**Create: Dreams n' Desires to Create 6** is a compatibility bridge designed to enable **Create v6.0.4 - v6.0.8** to function alongside **[Create: Dreams n' Desires](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dreams-and-desires) [v0.2c-ALPHA](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dreams-and-desires/version/1.20.1-0.2c.PREBETA)**.  
Please note that support is currently limited to these specific versions.  
At this time, there are no plans to support future versions of _Create: Dreams n' Desires_.

This compatibility layer was built exclusively for the  
[**Create: Forge Frontier**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/forge-frontier) modpack, which relies on core features introduced in _Dreams n' Desires_.

> ⚠️ **Disclaimer:** This mod has not been tested extensively outside of its intended use case.  
> While it should function alongside most mods, compatibility is not guaranteed.
> 
> There is a known incompatability with Sinytra Connector, which we do not currently have a timeline on a fix for.

If you encounter any issues or conflicts, please report them via our  
[**GitHub repository**](https://github.com/Landscapes-Reimagined/Issues-and-Suggestions) or join the discussion on our  
[**Discord server**](https://discord.gg/quenZthXgy).

> ❌ This mod is not intended to work with or support other mods,  
> and we currently do not plan to create similar compatibility patches for additional mods, though we invite you to suggest them in our Discord server.
